summary.text: Jack Lewis is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Middlesex District since January 4, 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jack Patrick Lewis has held the 7th Middlesex District seat since January 4, 2017, according to Ballotpedia.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Municipalities and Regional Government Joint Committee; for 2023-2024 he chaired the Federal Stimulus and Census Oversight Committee.
